blockers: The character does not read cleanly at native scale: the black corset, rapier, legs, and background repeatedly collapse into near-identical dark masses.

The idle and gesture strips show insufficient visible motion. Most frames are near-duplicates, so the character reads as a static cutout rather than a deliberately restrained breathing and gesturing performer.

Locomotion lacks convincing contact mechanics. Foot placement and leg extension do not establish a strong contact-pass-lift rhythm, making the gait appear stiff and potentially slide-prone despite the correct global anchor.
The face is not structurally readable at 128px. The dark spherical head and tiny facial marks provide weak identity and risk reading as a glossy mannequin or helmet rather than Celina.
The rapier is frequently lost against the dark palette and checkerboard, removing a major silhouette and character-intent cue.
The supplied inspection uses a 3x nearest-neighbor enlargement rather than the requested 4x comparison, leaving the required native-versus-4x pixel-readability validation incomplete.
high_value_changes: Redesign the value hierarchy: separate obsidian corset, navy fabric, metallic blue armor, and shadowed limbs with deliberate stepped value bands rather than relying on smooth blue highlights.
Give the head a readable facial plane: establish a clear hair/head silhouette, eye placement, nose or mask plane, and a controlled highlight pattern that survives native-scale viewing.
Strengthen the rapier with a brighter, selectively separated blade edge and a clearer guard/hilt silhouette; prevent it from merging with the body and background.

Rebuild the idle as a restrained but legible performance: subtle chest rise, collar or shoulder settling, hand tension, and a controlled head adjustment with distinct extreme, passing, and settle frames.

Re-time locomotion around explicit foot contacts. Hold contact frames long enough to read, keep the planted foot spatially stable, and use hip/torso counter-motion instead of moving only the feet and arms.
Make the gesture use anticipation, a single intentional extension, overshoot, and settle. The current repeated arm changes are too small and mechanically uniform to communicate controlled authority.
Increase silhouette rhythm by separating the forearms, skirt or leg masses, sword line, and feet in at least the key front, three-quarter, and side poses.
optional_notes: The 125.6px standing height and zero anchor drift are solid technical results, but they do not compensate for weak local motion and material readability.
The front-facing pose has a strong narrow vertical profile, but the oversized blue leg masses dominate the design and make the torso and face feel under-articulated.
Thin gold trim and small white accessories are likely to flicker or disappear at native scale; reserve them for accents that reinforce form rather than carrying structural information.
The checkerboard inspection makes dark-edge evaluation difficult. Include a flat near-black background, flat light background, native 1x, and 4x nearest-neighbor crops for final review.
regressions_from_previous: No previous-round visual sheet or scored baseline was supplied, so specific regressions cannot be verified.

Compared with the stated intended archetype, the current result still regresses conceptually toward an inert mannequin: restraint is present, but deliberate control and personality are not yet visibly distinguished from lack of animation.
strongest_improvements: Standing-height compliance and exact ground anchoring are reliable.
The overall navy, blue, brass, and white accent palette establishes a coherent character family.
The narrow vertical silhouette and closed posture communicate containment more successfully than an exaggerated action pose would.
Eight-direction coverage is complete and broadly consistent in overall proportions.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the native-scale readability and animation pass together: clarify the face, corset, feet, and rapier with stronger value-separated silhouettes, then animate a visibly structured contact/anticipation/overshoot/settle cycle so Celina reads as deliberately controlled rather than static and mannequin-like.
